description: Repaint the masked part of an image (black in the mask = repaint) with Ideogram 3.0 or its character / custom-model variants. Needs the source and the mask, each a local file, a public https URL or an Ideogram asset. Results are saved to the output directory; ideogram_quote prices a call first (nothing is generated).

character_reference_asset_identifiers.description: Ideogram assets to use as the character reference

character_reference_images.description: Local image files (or public https URLs) of the character to keep consistent

character_reference_mask.description: Local grayscale mask (or a public https URL) of where the character is in its reference image

custom_model_uri.description: A custom model you trained or were given access to

enable_copyright_detection.description: Run Ideogram's copyright detection on the result (adds latency)

image.description: Local image file to work on, or a public https URL of one

image_asset_identifier.description: An Ideogram asset (an upload or an earlier result) instead of a local image

inline_images.description: true: each saved image is also returned as image content (base64; one over 3.75 MB, or past 10 MB in total, by path only), for a client without file access

magic_prompt.description: auto, on or off: let Ideogram rewrite the prompt

mask.description: Local mask image file or a public https URL, the same size as the source

mask_asset_identifier.description: An Ideogram asset to use as the mask

model.description: The model (default ideogram-3); each takes the fields of its variant below

num_images.description: How many images to make (each is billed)

private.description: Keep the result out of Ideogram's public feed; true unless you set false (enterprise accounts are always private)

prompt.description: What to create or change, in natural language

rendering_speed.description: turbo, default or quality: faster is cheaper

seed.description: Random seed for a reproducible result

style_preset.description: A named style preset; not with style codes or style references

style_reference_asset_identifiers.description: Ideogram assets (uploads or earlier results) to use as style references

style_reference_collection_id.description: A saved style collection to apply

style_reference_collection_version_id.description: A version of the saved style collection

style_reference_images.description: Local image files (or public https URLs) whose style the result follows

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait for the result (0-50, default 45). The job is accepted first; if it is still running when the wait ends, the result is its generation_id for ideogram_generation (never resubmitted, never billed twice).

name: ideogram_inpaint
title: Inpaint an image
